fullName.value: Tumor necrosis factor superfamily member 5-induced protein 1

texts.value: Chaperone protein which promotes assembly of the 20S proteasome as part of a heterodimer with PSMG1. The PSMG1-PSMG2 heterodimer binds to the PSMA5 and PSMA7 proteasome subunits, promotes assembly of the proteasome alpha subunits into the heteroheptameric alpha ring and prevents alpha ring dimerization

Forms a heterodimer with PSMG1. The PSMG1-PSMG2 heterodimer interacts directly with the PSMA5 and PSMA7 proteasome alpha subunits (PubMed:16251969). Interacts with RHBDF1/iRhom1; the interaction promotes or stabilizes formation of the PSMG1-PSMG2 heterodimer (PubMed:26109405)

Widely expressed with highest levels in lung, brain and colon. Moderately expressed in muscle, stomach, spleen and heart. Weakly expressed in small intestine, pancreas and liver. Highly expressed in hepatocellular carcinomas with low levels in surrounding liver tissue
Degraded by the proteasome upon completion of 20S proteasome maturation

disease.description: An autosomal recessive, autoinflammatory disorder characterized by panniculitis and erythematous skin lesions apparent in early infancy. Additional features include hepatosplenomegaly, lymphadenopathy, autoimmune hemolytic anemia, fever, generalized lipodystrophy, myositis, joint contractures, and mild motor and speech delay.

texts.value: The disease may be caused by variants affecting the gene represented in this entry
